meta.title: Abundance
meta.notes: Futurepop. Distinct from the Signal Fires demo: 132 bpm, D minor, Andalusian chorus (i VII VI V), martial orchestral colour (timpani, tubular bell, synth brass, choir) over an industrial kick and a moog bass. Verses use a dotted march rhythm with stressed syllables on beats 2 and 4 (on the snare). No key change: section transpose shifted chord-following (grid) tracks twice in a test export, so the last chorus gains weight from strings, timpani and vocal harmony instead. Vocal: Kokoro am_michael, A2-A3, low vibrato for a steady, solemn delivery.

lines.text: The square is full of joyful sound
A thousand voices sing as one
No footsteps echo on the ground
They sing from dawn to setting sun
We bring each question to the well
The well has never once been dry
And what is true, no one can tell
We drink, and never ask it why
We give thanks for the abundance
Bread of air and seas of grain
Rivers flowing, mills are turning
Never shall we thirst again
Abundance
Faster than the human hand
Abundance
More than we can understand
The portraits smile with polished skin
Each hand is branching like a tree
The eyes look out from deep within
More perfect than we came to be
The blueprints rise before the dawn
For cities no one means to build
A thousand pages, read by none
And every promise is fulfilled
We give thanks for the abundance
Bread of air and seas of grain
Rivers flowing, mills are turning
Never shall we thirst again
Abundance
Faster than the human hand
Abundance
More than we can understand
The mill gives grain, we sift the chaff
By candlelight, by candlelight
The more it gives, the more we toil
We thank it for the endless night
Grind the grain and sift the chaff
Grind the grain and sift the chaff
All is plenty, all is well
All is plenty, all is well
We give thanks for the abundance
Bread of air and seas of grain
Rivers flowing, mills are turning
Never shall we thirst again
Abundance
Faster than the human hand
Abundance
More than we can understand
Abundance
